说明: 规则夹具：每条规则带 positive（必须命中）/ negative（必须不命中）。$1..$9 引用捕获组。draft=候选规则，active=已实装规则。memo=人工复核意见（写进复核表末列）。

rules.note: #66：JournalMapNote::Reveal —— `in the {{W|PAGE > CAT}} section of your journal`
rules.regex: ^You note the location of (.+?) in (?:the )?(?:\{\{W\|)?(.+?)\s*[>›]\s*(.+?)(?:\}\})? section of (?:your|你的) journal\.$
rules.replacement: 你在日志的$2 › $3栏记下了$1的位置。
positives: You note the location of 一支驼人商队 in the {{W|位置 › 商人}} section of your journal.
You note the location of Sithis，传奇蝎蚂的巢穴 in {{W|地点 › 巢穴}} section of your journal.
You note the location of Alailitara in 地点 › 聚落 section of 你的 journal.
negatives: You note the location of the rusted gate.
You note this piece of information in the {{W|村落史 › Sharshiwar}} section of your journal.
You note the location of X in the 地点 › 巢穴 section of her journal.

rules.note: #67：声望下降句（带中文原因前缀）
rules.regex: ^(.+?)，你的 reputation with (.+?) decreased by (\d+) to (-?\d+)\.$
positives: 因为他们鄙视看守 Qan，你的 reputation with 海胆 decreased by 100 to -600.
negatives: Your reputation with 海胆 decreased by 100 to -600.
因为他们鄙视看守 Qan，你的 reputation with 海胆 increased by 100 to 600.

rules.note: #67：`You are now despised by X.`（等级词单独成条，避免 `standing by` 误伤）
rules.memo: 用户 2026-10-18：「你如今被海胆鄙视」
positives: You are now despised by 海胆.
negatives: You are now standing by the gate.
You are now despised of 海胆.

rules.memo: 用户 2026-10-18：「你如今被约帕喜爱」
positives: You are now liked by 约帕.

rules.note: #69：水之仪式 —— `Your reputation with X is -50.`
positives: Your reputation with 看守联盟 is -50.
Your reputation with 海胆 is 100.
negatives: Your reputation with 海胆 decreased by 100 to -600.
